device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, external IR sensor / 4-digit LED eye, and USB PVR
device.board: 20020A00 (bootloader version "M3510B 1.1.1", 128 MB DDR3 M3503 revision B platform)
device.soc: ALi M3510B / M3503 rev B (128 MB DDR3 dual-CPU DVB-S2 SoC reading chip ID 0x3503 rev 0x0001; NIM_S3503_0, OSD_M36F_0/1, seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)
device.demod: internal ALi M3503 / M3510B DVB-S2 (NIM_S3503_0 at 0xB8028000)
device.tuner: Airoha AV2026 DVB-S2 tuner + ASC RF374 modulator

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_Impulse_SAT_2.3.45_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-03.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_impulse_sat_2345_app_starts.py, run_dump_impulse_sat_2345_capture_screen.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1") runs from flash using CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF before relocating to DDR, prints "CH455 panel init OK!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA141A7DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") and maincode(AV) ("20020A002345") to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE running at 0xA6000200 with EBase 0x86002001).  The application prints "---led 455 attach OK--", updates the CH455 panel to " on ", populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko Impulse SAT (System ID 20020A00) EMU firmware v2.3.45 emu for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3510B / M3503 rev B SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0xA6000200, and an external CH455 4-digit LED / IR sensor eye on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA).
